scripts.dryrun:staging: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging
scripts.dryrun:production: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: bun run build:client && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply dojo-d1-dev-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply dojo-d1-staging-db --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply dojo-d1-pro-db --env production --remote
scripts.test: bun run create:test:db && bun test && bun run destroy:test:db
